# Kingfisher

> Kingfisher is an open source secret scanner and credential-response tool. It
> detects exposed credentials, validates which are active, maps blast radius, supports visual
> triage, and revokes supported secrets.

Kingfisher is written in Rust and licensed under Apache-2.0. Use TOON output for LLM and agent
workflows: `kingfisher scan <target> --format toon --no-update-check`.

## Configuration and Extension

The bundled catalog has 503 rules. Default medium-confidence CLI/Python/Node loaders select
502 before native regex compilation, excluding static-low `betterleaks.generic-api-key`;
`--confidence low` or the SDK equivalent includes it. `betterleaks.generic-credential-uri` stays
medium; `generic-password` and `generic-username` are not bundled. Rule confidence is static:
no dynamic upgrades, demotions, or runtime confidence variants. Existing YAML/TOML files still
load; one-string `setConfidence(...)` and `filter.setConfidence(...)` calls are inert string
passthroughs, while rejection filters and association helpers remain active.
